dimensions.outcome: reproduced:<route or owning module> | diverged:<reason> | refused:<reason>

negativeControls.name: substituted_action
negativeControls.expectation: a re-signed record whose recorded action was changed replays to the true action and is diverged with reason action

negativeControls.name: substituted_rng
negativeControls.expectation: a re-signed record whose RNG stream was changed is refused as rng_stream_mismatch

negativeControls.name: stale_m_state
negativeControls.expectation: M evidence changed and re-signed under a valid decision key is disagreed by the independent m_state check and never reproduced

negativeControls.name: chart_store:journaled_identity_substituted
negativeControls.expectation: a re-signed record whose journaled chart_store digest names a different store of the same size is refused as reference_unavailable:chart_store, even with the true store loaded

negativeControls.name: chart_store:journaled_identity_without_pin
negativeControls.expectation: a record that journaled its store identity reproduces against the loaded store by digest alone, with no pin

negativeControls.name: chart_store:same_count_tampered
negativeControls.expectation: a store with the same 240 entries and one changed frequency (digest c202612f0c72) is refused as reference_unavailable:chart_store

negativeControls.name: chart_store:restored
negativeControls.expectation: the untampered snapshot reloaded through the store module reproduces the same decisions again
